label: Values
help: Each side wants a different world. Most outer squares are this.

label: Means
help: They agree on why. They fight about how.

label: Cost
help: They agree on the goal. They fight about what it's worth paying.

label: Purity
help: They agree on the mission. They fight about how far it can bend.

label: Leadership
help: They agree where to go. They fight about who decides.

label: Secret
help: They share a motive. Each one hides something different.

label: What winning means
help: They all want to win. They disagree on what a win looks like.

label: Dilemma
help: One question with no clean answer. Each corner is a way of living with it.
